'''Pokémon: Discover Paldea''' (Japanese: '''パルデア再発見''' ''Rediscover Paldea'') is a online series of {{pkmn|animation|animated}} shorts released directly on the official English [[Pokémon]] [[YouTube]] channel. The shorts center on four [[Paldea]]n Trainers as well as their Pokémon, being {{p|Pikachu}}, [[Paldean form|Paldean]] {{p|Wooper}}, {{p|Milotic}} and {{p|Hydrapple}}, taking part in activities from {{g|Scarlet and Violet}}. Each short ties into an event that was active in the aforementioned games at the time of their upload. While not a direct continuation of the series, the shorts share some similarities to [[Discover Pokémon Together]]. ==List of shorts== {{Episodelistheader|SV}} {{Episodelistbody|None|[[#Picnic Pandemonium|Picnic Pandemonium]]|ピクニックで大パニック！|Big Panic at the Picnic!|January 16, 2025|January 18, 2025|Pokémon Discover Paldea 1.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|[[#A Flock of Flamigo|A Flock of Flamigo]]|カラミンゴの群れミンゴ|A Flock-mingo of {{tt|Karamingo|Flamigo}}|January 16, 2025|January 18, 2025|Pokémon Discover Paldea 2.png}} {{Episodelistbody|None|[[#Tera Raid Team-Up|Tera Raid Team-Up]]|テラレイドバトルに挑もうよ！|Let's Challenge the Tera Raid Battle!|January 16, 2025|January 19, 2025|Pokémon Discover Paldea 3.png}} {{Episodelistfooterspecial|SV|This concludes Pokémon: Discover Paldea.}} ==''Picnic Pandemonium''== {{YouTubeEmbed|B1EmIHdAsFk|Pokemon|color={{colorschemelight|Hoso}}|colorlight={{colorschemelight|Hoso}}|colordark={{colorschemedark|Hoso}}}} ===Summary=== The group of Trainers, along with their Pokémon, are gathered for a [[Picnic|picnic]]. The Trainers decide to assemble a sandwich; the Milotic Trainer adds [[Sweet Herba Mystica|Sweet]] and [[Spicy Herba Mystica]] to the bread as the other three Trainers add several other ingredients, creating a tall sandwich that nearly topples over, worrying the Trainers. However, once the Hydrapple Trainer places a [[Red Poké Ball Pick]], the sandwich remains in place and the Milotic Trainer takes a group photo to commemorate the occasion. ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Milotic}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]) * {{p|Hydrapple}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Pikachu}} (Trainer's) * [[Paldean form|Paldean]] {{p|Wooper}} (Trainer's) ==''A Flock of Flamigo''== {{YouTubeEmbed|dbQNcILAVXc|Pokemon|color={{colorschemelight|Hoso}}|colorlight={{colorschemelight|Hoso}}|colordark={{colorschemedark|Hoso}}}} ===Summary=== After seeing an image of [[Poké_Portal_News#January_17_to_19,_2025|a mass outbreak of Flamigo]] on their Rotom Phone, the Wooper Trainer leads their group to [[South Province (Area Four)]] to track them down. The group locates the Flamigo flock and each go after a different Flamigo - the Wooper Trainer targets one Flamigo with her Wooper's {{m|Sludge Bomb}}, enraging it. Meanwhile, Hydrapple begins chasing a Flamigo, though it soon becomes distracted by a [[Pecha Berry]], much to the dismay of its Trainer. The Milotic Trainer locates a {{Shiny}} Flamigo and aims to capture it. Pikachu also battles a Flamigo, allowing its Trainer to capture it. The Trainers prepare for a group photo, but are quickly surrounded by the Flamigo flock, who proceed to twirl around them before dispersing. Milotic's Trainer takes a celebratory group photo with the other Trainers next to a {{t|Dragon}}-type [[Tera Raid Battle]] den, revealing that they successfully captured the Shiny Flamigo. ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Flamigo}} (Trainer's; {{Shiny}}; new) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]) * {{p|Hydrapple}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Pikachu}} (Trainer's) * [[Paldean form|Paldean]] {{p|Wooper}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Milotic}} (Trainer's) ==''Tera Raid Team-Up''== {{YouTubeEmbed|mMxkBW9Vm7g|Pokemon|color={{colorschemelight|Hoso}}|colorlight={{colorschemelight|Hoso}}|colordark={{colorschemedark|Hoso}}}} ===Summary=== The group of four trainers enter a [[Tera Raid Battle]], where they encounter [[Poké Portal News#January 17 to 19, 2025 2|a powerful Alolan Exeggutor with the Dragon Tera Type]]. They each send out their Pokémon — Pikachu, Paldean Wooper, Milotic and Hydrapple — to battle. Hydrapple cowers in fear at the Coconut Pokémon as its Trainer attempts to calm it. Meanwhile, the other three Pokémon are on the offensive, each attacking the Exeggutor as their Trainers throw their [[Tera Orb|Tera Orbs]], causing them to {{Tera}}stallize. Seeing the strength of its allies, its Trainer performs a heal cheer to support them, though Hydrapple is still hesitant to take part in the battle. The Exeggutor begins to gather a tremendous energy, indicating that there is little time remaining before the Trainers are expelled from the raid. Hydrapple's Trainer encourages it one last time to aid its allies, but the central syrpent is hesitant - however, the other syrpents encourage it, and together the heads fire off a powerful {{m|Fickle Beam}}, defeating the fearsome raid boss. Hydrapple's Trainer captures the Exeggutor, and Milotic's Trainer takes a group photo with the others in celebration of their victory. ===Pokémon=== * [[Alolan form|Alolan]] {{p|Exeggutor}} * {{p|Pikachu}} (Trainer's) * [[Paldean form|Paldean]] {{p|Wooper}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Milotic}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Hydrapple}} (Trainer's) * {{p|Rotom}} ([[Rotom Phone]]) ==In other languages== {{Epilang|color={{colorschemedark|Paldea}}|bordercolor={{colorschemelight|Paldea}} |zh_yue=寶可夢：發現帕底亞 ''Bóuhómuhng: Faatyihn Paakdáia'' |zh_cmn=寶可夢：發現帕底亞 ''Bǎokěmèng: Fāxiàn Pàdǐyǎ'' |fr=Pokémon : à la découverte de Paldea |de=Pokémon: Entdecke Paldea |it=Pokémon: Scopri Paldea |ko=디스커버 팔데아 ''Discover Paldea'' |es_la=Pokémon: Descubre Paldea |es_eu=Pokémon: Descubre Paldea }}
